name: Iron Man
tagline: The armored pioneer of the Marvel Cinematic Universe
biography: Anthony Edward 'Tony' Stark was an eccentric industrialist who inherited Stark Industries from his father Howard Stark. After being ambushed and captured by the Ten Rings terrorist group in Afghanistan, Stark suffered shrapnel injuries near his heart. Refusing to build missiles for his captors, he forged an electromagnetic chest arc reactor and the rudimentary Mark I armor with Dr. Ho Yinsen. Returning to Malibu, he refined the technology into high-altitude powered suits, shut down Stark Industries' weapons manufacturing, and publicly announced 'I am Iron Man.' Stark became a core architect of the Avengers, faced alien incursions, survived PTSD, and ultimately laid down his life in 2023 by channeling the Infinity Stones to eliminate Thanos and his army.
powers: Genius-level intellect and engineering mastery
Armor-enabled supersonic flight and maneuverability
Repulsor beam projection from palms and chest Unibeam
Micro-missile salvos and nanotech weapon morphing
Enhanced physical durability and superhuman strength

Arc Reactor technology
F.R.I.D.A.Y. & J.A.R.V.I.S. artificial intelligence systems

Nano Gauntlet

name: Thor
tagline: Asgardian god of thunder and founding Avenger
biography: Thor Odinson is the Asgardian God of Thunder and son of King Odin Borson and Queen Frigga. Initially arrogant and eager for war against the Frost Giants, Thor was stripped of his divine abilities and cast down to Earth as a mortal until he proved himself worthy to wield the enchanted hammer Mjolnir. Learning humility, selflessness, and valor, Thor became a founding cornerstone of the Avengers. Across his journey, Thor endured the destruction of Asgard during Ragnarok, the deaths of his brother Loki, parents, and closest companions, yet channeled his grief into forged resolve, wielding the devastating king's weapon Stormbreaker to turn the tide against Thanos.
powers: Godlike superhuman physical strength, stamina, and longevity
Atmospheric electrokinesis and weather control
Dimensional traversal via the Bifrost Bridge
Flight propulsion through Mjolnir and Stormbreaker
Electrified energy projection without external foci
equipment: Mjolnir (Uru hammer enchanted by Odin)
Stormbreaker (Forged by Eitri on Nidavellir)
Asgardian royal armor and crimson cloak

name: Captain America
aliases: The Star-Spangled Man with a Plan
tagline: The First Avenger and moral compass of Earth's Mightiest Heroes
biography: Steven Grant Rogers was an impoverished Brooklyn art student rejected repeatedly from WWII military service due to a litany of chronic health issues. Dr. Abraham Erskine recognized his profound moral resolve, selecting him for the Project Rebirth Super Soldier program. Transformed into peak human perfection, Rogers led the Howling Commandos behind enemy lines to dismantle Johann Schmidt's HYDRA operations. After plunging a Valkyrie super-bomber into the Arctic ice to save millions, Rogers awoke 66 years later into the 21st century. As tactical leader of the Avengers, Cap defended humanity against aliens, corrupt secret organizations, and rogue androids, consistently standing unwavering against tyranny.

Mastery of master-level hand-to-hand martial combat and shield aerodynamics
Accelerated cellular healing and immunity to terrestrial intoxicants
Supreme battlefield tactics and inspirational leadership
Demonstrated worthiness to summon and wield Mjolnir

name: Spider-Man
tagline: Queens' friendly neighborhood wall-crawler and junior Avenger
biography: Peter Benjamin Parker was an orphaned Queens high school student living with his Aunt May who gained arachnid abilities after being bitten by a radioactive spider. Operating secretly in homemade gear as a local crimefighter, he was recruited by Tony Stark during the Avengers' clash over the Sokovia Accords. Equipped with high-tech Stark suits, Parker halted Adrian Toomes' scavenged weapons network and joined the Avengers on Titan against Thanos. Following the Blip and Stark's demise, Peter was framed for Mysterio's London drone assault and unmasked to the globe by J. Jonah Jameson. Desperate to restore his friends' lives, Peter turned to Doctor Strange for a memory charm that fractured the multiverse, ultimately sacrificing his entire personal identity so the cosmos could heal.

Superhuman proportionate spider strength and agility
Precognitive danger reflex ('Peter-Tingle' / Spider-Sense)
Acrobatic equilibrium and heightened kinetic perception

name: Star-Lord
aliases: Leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy
tagline: The mixtape-loving leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy
biography: Peter Jason Quill was born in Missouri to human Meredith Quill and the cosmic Celestial entity Ego. Following his mother's tragic passing from brain cancer in 1988, eight-year-old Peter was abducted into space by Yondu Udonta and the Ravagers. Rather than delivering him to Ego, Yondu raised Quill as a scavenger and thief. Adopting his mother's pet name 'Star-Lord', Quill stole an orb containing the Power Stone on Morag, triggering a cascade of events that united him with Gamora, Drax, Rocket, and Groot. As captain of the Milano, Quill transformed his found family of eccentric outlaws into the premier guardians of cosmic peace.

Expert hand-to-hand combat and guerrilla marksmanship
Celestial heritage enabling temporary physical channeling of Infinity Stones
Acrobatic jet-boot maneuvering

name: Spider-Man
tagline: The definitive Columbia Pictures trilogy web-slinger
biography: Peter Parker was a shy, bookish Midtown High student raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May in Forest Hills, Queens. During a high school field trip to Columbia University, he was bitten by a genetically designed super-spider, manifesting superhuman reflexes, sticky fingertips, and organic spinnerets inside his wrists. Initially chasing prize money as 'The Human Spider' in an underground wrestling ring, Peter neglected to stop an armed robber who minutes later murdered Uncle Ben. Haunted by Ben's words—'With great power comes great responsibility'—Peter committed his life to protecting New York City. Later pulled into the MCU through Doctor Strange's destabilized spell, he aided his younger counterpart variants in curing his old adversaries.

Superhuman proportionate arachnid strength, agility, and reflexes
Wall-crawling surface adhesion through micro-structures

name: Spider-Man
tagline: The brilliant Oscorp skateboarder and acrobatic protector of Manhattan
biography: Peter Parker was an inquisitive science student abandoned by his parents, geneticist Richard Parker and Mary Parker, under mysterious circumstances. Uncovering his father's old briefcase led Peter directly into Oscorp, where he snuck into the biocable laboratory and was bitten by a genetically altered arachnid. Leveraging his father's decay rate algorithm, Peter designed high-tensile mechanical web-shooters using Oscorp biocable. After a burglar shot Uncle Ben, Peter spent months tracking the killer before embracing heroic purpose as Spider-Man. The devastating loss of Gwen Stacy at the hands of the Green Goblin sent Peter into a dark spiral until being pulled across dimensions to the MCU, where catching MJ granted him profound personal redemption.

Dynamic acrobatic agility and proportionate spider strength
Hyper-reactive spider-sense precognition
Scientific genius in biochemistry and electrical engineering

name: Spider-Man
tagline: Brooklyn's teenage Spider-Man charting his own heroic rhythm
biography: Miles Morales was an artistic Brooklyn high schooler attending Visions Academy whose life changed when bitten in an abandoned subway station by an interdimensional spider from Earth-42. Witnessing the tragic death of his universe's Peter Parker at the hands of Kingpin, Miles promised to disable the Super-Collider. Mentored by an out-of-shape Peter B. Parker from Earth-616 and bonding with Gwen Stacy, Miles embraced his leap of faith to become Brooklyn's new Spider-Man. In Across the Spider-Verse, Miles learned from Miguel O'Hara that his origin violated the multiverse's canon events, sparking an intense rebellion to save both his father and the fabric of reality.

Adaptive camouflage / optic invisibility
Proportionate spider strength, wall-crawling, and heightened agility

name: Spider-Gwen
tagline: The rhythm-driven web-warrior of Earth-65
biography: Hailing from Earth-65, teenager Gwen Stacy was bitten by a radioactive spider, becoming Spider-Woman while playing drums in The Mary Janes rock band. When her universe's Peter Parker transformed into the Lizard to defend himself against bullies and died in her arms, her father Captain George Stacy led a citywide manhunt against her. Sucked through Kingpin's collider into Earth-1610, Gwen formed an indelible bond with Miles Morales. Later recruited into Miguel O'Hara's elite multiversal Spider-Society, Gwen ultimately chose to break ranks to assemble her own band of spider-allies to rescue Miles.

Proportionate arachnid physical strength and endurance

name: Spider-Man 2099
tagline: The relentless architect and protector of multiversal canon events
biography: Miguel O'Hara is a brilliant geneticist from Nueva York on Earth-928 who spliced his DNA with spider genes. Unlike most spider-heroes, Miguel possesses retractable talons, fangs that secrete non-lethal paralytic venom, and red laser webs, while lacking organic wall-adhesion and a conventional spider-sense. After attempting to replace a deceased alternate version of himself and inadvertently causing an entire universe's unraveling, Miguel founded the multiversal Spider-Society at the Citadel to ruthlessly protect predetermined canon events across realities.

Fangs delivering paralyzing venom

name: Wolverine
tagline: The adamantium-clawed mutant survivor who defined superhero cinema
biography: Born in 19th-century Canada as James Howlett, Logan discovered his mutation when bone claws erupted from his hands in childhood. Possessing an accelerated cellular healing factor and heightened animalistic senses, Logan survived centuries of battlefield combat across the Civil War, World War I, World War II, and Vietnam alongside his half-brother Victor Creed. Recruited into Col. William Stryker's Team X, Logan was later subjected to the Weapon X program, fusing unbreakable molten adamantium to his skeletal frame. Joining Charles Xavier's X-Men, Logan became the fierce protector of mutantkind, sacrificing himself in 2029 to ensure the survival of Laura and the mutant youth in Logan, before a multiversal worst-variant variant was drafted into the MCU Void alongside Deadpool in 2024.

Six retractable razor-sharp bone claws coated in indestructible adamantium

name: Professor X
tagline: The telepathic visionary fighting for human-mutant coexistence
biography: Professor Charles Francis Xavier is an exceptionally powerful mutant telepath who dedicated his life and inherited Westchester fortune to establishing Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters. Believing passionately that mutants and humans can peacefully share the Earth, Xavier created the X-Men to defend both species against human bigotry and mutant extremism. Utilizing Cerebro, a spherical neural amplifier, Xavier could track mutant signatures globally. Despite enduring paralysis, government hostility, and the devastation of Sentinel timelines, Xavier's unwavering optimism guided generations of mutant heroes, including an alternate reality counterpart who chaired Earth-838's Illuminati.

name: Professor X (Young)
tagline: The young Oxford scholar who built the first class of X-Men
biography: Charles Xavier in his youth was a brilliant, charismatic Oxford graduate in genetics who grew up in Westchester alongside his foster sister Raven Darkhölme. In 1962, CIA agent Moira MacTaggert recruited Xavier to investigate Sebastian Shaw's Hellfire Club during the Cuban Missile Crisis. Partnering with Erik Lehnsherr, Charles recruited young mutants to create the original First Class of X-Men. When a deflected bullet severed Charles' spine during the missile standoff on the Cuban beach, his divergent worldview from Magneto cemented their tragic rift. Charles persevered through personal despair, learning in Days of Future Past to channel hope rather than fear.
powers: World-class mutant telepathy
Direct mental link and illusion manipulation
Mind-wipe and consciousness shielding
equipment: Original spherical prototype Cerebro built by Hank McCoy
Manual wheelchair

name: Magneto
tagline: The Master of Magnetism championing mutant survival at all costs
biography: Erik Magnus Lehnsherr survived the horrors of the Auschwitz concentration camp in WWII, where the trauma of losing his parents triggered his catastrophic mutant mastery over magnetic fields. Hardened by humanity's propensity for systematic genocide, Erik came to believe that the burgeoning mutant race (Homo superior) could never safely coexist with Homo sapiens. As Magneto, he forged the militant Brotherhood of Mutants, utilizing metal manipulation to weaponize everything from the Golden Gate Bridge to tactical nuclear missiles. Despite his ruthless methods, Magneto shared an unbreakable bond of mutual respect with Charles Xavier, repeatedly uniting with the X-Men when total extinction threatened their kind.

Magnetic flight and levitation via polarized field shields
Generation of impenetrable magnetic kinetic force barriers
Molecular metal manipulation and reshaping

name: Magneto (Young)
tagline: The vengeful Nazi hunter who forged the Brotherhood's identity
biography: Following WWII, a young Erik Lehnsherr hunted escaped Nazi war criminals across the globe to avenge his mother's murder by Sebastian Shaw (Klaus Schmidt). In 1962, Charles Xavier pulled him from the ocean when Erik attempted to drag down Shaw's submarine with his magnetism alone. Charles helped Erik discover that true magnetic power lies between rage and serenity. After executing Shaw with a slow-moving Nazi coin through the brain, Erik seized Shaw's telepathy-blocking helmet and parted ways with Charles. Across the alternate 1973 timeline and the rise of Apocalypse, Erik oscillated between destructive vengeance and profound grief.
powers: Raw magnetic field generation capable of lifting naval battleships and soccer stadiums
Metal manipulation down to the microscopic iron traces in human blood
Magnetic flight and concussive kinetic blasts
equipment: Sebastian Shaw's stolen Soviet-engineered anti-telepathy helmet
Armor with flowing dark cape

name: Deadpool
tagline: The fourth-wall-shattering mercenary who rescued the multiverse
biography: Wade Winston Wilson was a dishonorably discharged Special Forces operative operating as a New York city mercenary. Diagnosed with late-stage terminal cancer in his liver, lungs, prostate, and brain, Wade submitted to Ajax (Francis Freeman) in the underground Weapon X workshop. Injected with mutant serum and subjected to oxygen-deprivation torture, Wade unlocked a hyper-accelerated cellular regenerative healing factor that rendered him virtually unkillable, while leaving his skin severely scarred. Adopting the moniker Deadpool, Wade paired razor-sharp wit and dual katanas with fourth-wall awareness. Pulled into the TVA's multiversal affairs, Wade teamed up with a heartbroken Wolverine variant to save his universe from destruction.

Fourth-wall breakage and meta-awareness of cinematic and comic continuity
Mastery of dual-wielded katanas, firearms, and guerrilla assassination
Superhuman pain tolerance, agility, and kinetic dexterity

name: Mister Fantastic
tagline: The hyper-elastic scientific patriarch of the Fantastic Four
biography: Dr. Reed Richards was an ambitious polymath and theoretical physicist who funded an expedition into deep space to study cosmic radiation cloud patterns. When the cloud arrived early, Richards and his crew—Sue Storm, Johnny Storm, Ben Grimm, and Victor von Doom—were irradiated. Returning to Earth, Richards discovered his molecular structure had mutated, permitting him to stretch, deform, expand, and compress his body into nearly any geometric configuration. Establishing the Baxter Building as their headquarters, Reed balanced groundbreaking physics with public heroism, neutralizing Victor's metallic menace and later teaming with the Silver Surfer to divert Galactus.

Shape alteration, elongation, and shock-absorbing expansion
World-leading genius in theoretical physics, astrophysics, and aerospace design

name: Invisible Woman
tagline: The force-field wielding heart of the Fantastic Four
biography: Dr. Susan Storm was a brilliant genetics researcher at Von Doom Industries and former girlfriend of Reed Richards. Accompanying Reed's cosmic cloud space station mission, Sue was inundated by cosmic radiation that unlocked the ability to manipulate light waves around her body to render herself invisible, as well as project invisible psionic force fields capable of stopping speeding trucks and redirecting thermal blasts. Balancing her affection for Reed with Victor von Doom's corporate advances, Sue proved to be the formidable emotional and tactical anchor of the Fantastic Four.

Projection of psionic force fields of varying density and geometric shape
Levitation and kinetic shockwave generation via force-field expansion

name: Human Torch
tagline: The thrill-seeking, flame-on flyer of the Fantastic Four
biography: Jonathan 'Johnny' Storm was an adventurous former NASA astronaut candidate and extreme-sports aficionado recruited onto Reed Richards' space expedition by his sister Sue. Exposed to cosmic rays, Johnny developed the power to envelop his body in fiery plasma without harming himself, project devastating flame bursts, and take flight by manipulating air currents. Flamboyant and loving the spotlight, Johnny coined the team's hero names and uniforms. In 2024, an alternate version of this Johnny Storm resurfaced in the Void under Cassandra Nova's rule in Deadpool & Wolverine, where his mouth got him in legendary trouble with the Merc with a Mouth.

name: The Thing
tagline: The clobberin'-time rock-solid heart of the Fantastic Four
biography: Benjamin Grimm was a seasoned astronaut, pilot, and college football star who joined his college roommate Reed Richards' space mission as pilot. When the cosmic ray cloud struck the station while Ben was on an exterior spacewalk, his physiology was completely transmuted into a massive, orange, rock-like dermal armor. Possessing immense superhuman strength, Ben struggled with his public monstrous appearance before embracing his heroic identity, famous for his battle cry: 'It's Clobberin' Time!'

Near-invulnerable rock-hard epidermal armor impervious to ballistics and extreme temperatures

name: Doctor Doom
tagline: The metallic, electric monarch of Latveria
biography: Victor von Doom was a ruthless billionaire industrialist, head of Von Doom Industries, and former university rival of Reed Richards. Financing Reed's space station exploration in exchange for majority profit rights, Victor was caught in the cosmic ray cloud after a shielding breach. Unlike his companions whose changes were immediate, Victor's body slowly ossified into organic metallic alloy while gaining the power to absorb, channel, and discharge high-voltage electricity. Blaming Reed for his company's bankruptcy and his physical condition, Doom donned a traditional Latverian metal mask and green hooded cloak, seeking vengeance on the Fantastic Four.

Electrokinesis and electrical energy projection from palms

tagline: The smartest man alive on Earth-838 and member of the Illuminati
biography: Dr. Reed Richards of Earth-838 was revered as the smartest man alive on his world and a prominent leader of the Illuminati alongside Charles Xavier, Black Bolt, Captain Carter, Captain Marvel (Maria Rambeau), and Karl Mordo. A devoted family man with a wife and children, Reed attempted to de-escalate the confrontation when a Darkhold-corrupted Wanda Maximoff dreamwalked into Earth-838 to seize America Chavez. Attempting to reason with Wanda by revealing his own fatherhood, Reed was shredded into ribbons when Wanda dismantled his elastic molecular bonds.

name: Blade
tagline: The legendary vampire-hunting Daywalker
biography: Eric Brooks was born after his pregnant mother was bitten by the vampire Deacon Frost in 1967, resulting in a hybrid physiology possessing all of a vampire's superhuman physical strengths, enhanced senses, and agility, without any vulnerability to sunlight, garlic, or silver—earning him the fearful title of 'The Daywalker.' Raised and armed by master armorer Abraham Whistler, Blade utilized an arsenal of customized silver weaponry, UV light explosives, and titanium swords to wage an unrelenting war against vampire syndicates. In 2024, Blade was discovered surviving in the Void in Deadpool & Wolverine, affirming to Wade that 'there's only ever gonna be one Blade.'

name: Venom
tagline: The chaotic investigative journalist and alien symbiote duo
biography: Eddie Brock was a dogged San Francisco investigative journalist whose career imploded when he confronted Life Foundation CEO Carlton Drake with stolen classified documents. Investigating Drake's human trials involving extraterrestrial symbiotes, Brock was bonded with the alien symbiote Venom. Despite initial terror, Brock and Venom formed an idiosyncratic symbiotic partnership, developing a shared palate for bad guys and tater tots. Together they defeated Riot, Carnage (Cletus Kasady), and multiversal incursions, briefly visiting the MCU timeline during Doctor Strange's spell before leaving a drop of symbiote behind.

Fluid shape-shifting, tendril generation, and web-like swinging lines

name: Green Goblin
tagline: The manic, glider-riding arch-nemesis of Spider-Man
biography: Dr. Norman Osborn was the brilliant, cutthroat founder and CEO of Oscorp Technologies. Facing the loss of crucial military contracts and imminent board dismissal, Osborn tested an unstable chemical performance enhancer on himself. The gas drastically augmented his physical strength and reflexes while fracturing his psyche, creating a sadistic alter ego that manifested as the Green Goblin. Riding a high-speed Goblin Glider and hurling explosive pumpkin bombs, Osborn terrorized New York City before fatally impaling himself on his own glider during a rooftop clash with Tobey Maguire's Spider-Man. Transported to the MCU during No Way Home, Osborn broke his mask and manipulated Peter Parker before being successfully cured.

Genius-level intellect in advanced weaponry and cybernetics
Unpredictable psychological warfare and manipulation

name: Doctor Octopus
aliases: The Power of the Sun in the Palm of My Hand
tagline: The four-tentacled fusion scientist who conquered his artificial mind
biography: Dr. Otto Octavius was a brilliant, compassionate nuclear scientist sponsored by Oscorp to achieve sustainable self-sustaining fusion power. To manipulate the dangerous fusion core safely, Octavius created four artificial-intelligence-assisted titanium mechanical tentacles fused to his spine, protected by a neural inhibitory chip. When the fusion experiment destabilized into a miniature artificial sun, the runaway energy overload fried the chip, allowing the tentacles' artificial intelligence to corrupt his mind. In Spider-Man 2, Peter Parker broke through the neural override, inspiring Octavius to sacrifice himself to drown the reactor. Pulled into the MCU just prior to his demise, Doc Ock was freed by Peter's new inhibitor chip and turned to aid the Spider-Men.

name: Electro
tagline: The living electrical lightning storm seeking recognition
biography: Maxwell 'Max' Dillon was a chronically overlooked and underappreciated electrical engineer at Oscorp who idolized Spider-Man after the hero saved his life in traffic. On his birthday, while attempting to repair a power cable over an Oscorp bio-electric vat, Dillon was electrocuted and fell into a holding tank of genetically modified electric eels. The incident mutated his cellular matrix into pure electrical current. Misunderstood and feeling betrayed when police attacked him in Times Square, Electro went on a rampage. In No Way Home, Electro crossed into the MCU and discovered that its dimensional grid gave him an uncorrupted golden charge, before Andrew Garfield's Peter Parker helped cure him.

name: Doctor Strange
tagline: Master of the Mystic Arts guarding the multiverse against catastrophic incursions
biography: Dr. Stephen Vincent Strange was an acclaimed but egotistical New York neurosurgeon whose hands were shattered in a devastating car accident. When modern medicine failed, Strange traveled to Kamar-Taj in Nepal, where the Ancient One revealed the mystic arts and alternate dimensions. Dedicated to the discipline of sorcery, Strange became master of the New York Sanctum, warded off Dormammu with the Time Stone, and orchestrated the one victory path out of 14,000,605 possibilities against Thanos in Endgame. After accidentally puncturing reality during a spell for Peter Parker, Strange journeyed through the multiverse to protect America Chavez from a grief-stricken Wanda Maximoff.
powers: Mastery of the Mystic Arts (Eldritch light shields, Tao mandalas, and portal creation)
Dimensional traversal and astral projection
Chronokinesis (former wielder of the Time Stone / Eye of Agamotto)
Darkhold dreamwalking and third eye awakening
equipment: Cloak of Levitation (sentient relic granting flight and defense)
Sling Ring for dimensional gateway travel
Eye of Agamotto talisman

name: Black Widow
tagline: The supreme S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and founding Avenger who wiped the red from her ledger
biography: Natasha Romanoff was taken as a young child into the Soviet Red Room academy, subjected to physiological augmentation and rigorous assassination training under General Dreykov. Sent on deadly missions, Romanoff's life changed when S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Clint Barton was sent to eliminate her but instead made a different call, recruiting her to the West. Romanoff became Director Nick Fury's most trusted operative, went undercover at Stark Industries, and became a founding cornerstone of the Avengers. In Avengers: Endgame, Natasha willingly sacrificed her life on Vormir against Clint Barton's protests to claim the Soul Stone and restore half of all life in the universe.
powers: Master hand-to-hand martial artist (Sambo, Judo, Karate, and Krav Maga)
Master covert spy, interrogator, and multi-lingual infiltrator
Expert marksmanship and precision weapons handling
equipment: Widow's Bite electroshock wrist gauntlets
Dual electrified batons
Glock 26 sidearms and grappling hooks

name: Hulk
tagline: The gamma-irradiated titan who fused brains with brawn
biography: Dr. Robert Bruce Banner was a renowned nuclear physicist who attempted to recreate Abraham Erskine's Super Soldier Serum using gamma radiation instead of Vita-Rays. When an experiment went awry, Banner shielded a colleague and absorbed a lethal dose of gamma rays, resulting in a cellular mutation that causes him to transform into the giant, rage-fueled Hulk whenever his heart rate spikes or emotions flare. Joining the Avengers, Banner spent years viewing the Hulk as a curse until retreating to a Mexican beach lab during the Blip, spending 18 months in a gamma chamber to merge Banner's genius intellect with the Hulk's physical invulnerability ('Smart Hulk'). In Endgame, Banner channeled the Nano Gauntlet to bring back everyone snapped away by Thanos.
powers: Virtually limitless superhuman strength scaling with emotional adrenaline
Near-absolute physical invulnerability and regenerative tissue repair
Colossal leaping capability crossing miles in a single bound
Genius-level intellect in nuclear physics, radiation, and quantum mechanics
equipment: Stretchy microfiber shorts and tactical glasses
Nano Gauntlet (wielded to resurrect the universe in Endgame)

name: Scarlet Witch
tagline: The mythical chaos-magic sorceress of devastating multiversal power
biography: Wanda Maximoff was a native of Sokovia who lost her parents to a Stark Industries mortar shell at age ten. Protesting foreign occupation, Wanda and her twin brother Pietro volunteered for Baron Wolfgang von Strucker's HYDRA experiments with Loki's scepter. The Mind Stone amplified her latent magical predisposition, granting her telekinesis, psionic energy projection, and telepathic hypnosis. Initially fighting the Avengers, the twins defected during the Battle of Sokovia. Wanda fell in love with Vision, but the trauma of losing him in Infinity War led her to rewrite Westview into a sitcom reality. Corrupted by the Darkhold, Wanda traversed dimensions seeking her children before ultimately bringing down Mount Wundagore to destroy the cursed text across the cosmos.

Telekinesis, flight, and psionic energy blast projection
Telepathy, mental persuasion, and nightmare inducement

name: Hawkeye
tagline: The peerless archer and grounding heart of the Avengers
biography: Clinton Francis Barton was an elite marksman recruited into S.H.I.E.L.D. by Director Nick Fury as one of the agency's primary tactical assets. Assigned to assassinate the Black Widow in Budapest, Barton defied orders to spare Romanoff, forging a legendary partnership. As a founding Avenger, Hawkeye fought in New York and Sokovia. When his entire family vanished during the Blip, grief drove Barton to adopt the blood-soaked persona of Ronin, slaughtering global criminal syndicates before Romanoff found him in Tokyo to bring him home for the Time Heist.
powers: Flawless peak-human marksmanship with bows, firearms, and thrown projectiles
Mastery of master-level hand-to-hand martial arts and swordsmanship (as Ronin)
Elite tactical reconnaissance and espionage

name: Black Panther
tagline: The noble warrior king who shared Wakanda's wonders with the world
biography: T'Challa was the crown prince of the technologically peerless African kingdom of Wakanda. Following the tragic assassination of his father King T'Chaka at the Vienna UN conference, T'Challa ascended the throne, ingesting the sacred Heart-Shaped Herb to receive the superhuman blessings of the Panther Goddess Bast. Defending his birthright against his cousin Erik Killmonger, T'Challa was transformed by Killmonger's righteous grief over global oppression, choosing to abandon Wakanda's centuries-long isolationism to build international outreach centers. T'Challa led Wakanda's armies in defense of the universe during the Infinity War and Endgame before his untimely passing.

Heightened senses and kinetic equilibrium
Supreme mastery of traditional Wakandan martial combat

name: Black Panther / Shuri
aliases: Head of the Wakandan Design Group
tagline: Wakanda's chief technological prodigy who stepped into the mantle of the Panther
biography: Princess Shuri is the head of the Wakandan Design Group, renowned globally as one of the most brilliant scientific minds on Earth. Shuri revolutionized Wakanda's technological infrastructure, developing kinetic panther habits, silent sneakers, and remote piloting technology. Following the devastating deaths of her brother T'Challa and mother Queen Ramonda, Shuri wrestled with vengeance against Namor and the underwater kingdom of Talokan. Using a synthetic Heart-Shaped Herb she genetically engineered, Shuri gained the powers of Bast, becoming the new Black Panther while ultimately choosing mercy over cyclical bloodshed.

World-class genius in engineering, artificial intelligence, and vibranium physics
Wakandan martial arts and twin energy gauntlet combat

name: Captain Marvel
tagline: The photon-charged cosmic avenger safeguarding galaxies across the universe
biography: Carol Susan Jane Danvers was an elite US Air Force test pilot working on Dr. Wendy Lawson's (Mar-Vell) experimental light-speed engine. When Kree warrior Yon-Rogg attacked their aircraft, Danvers shot the engine to prevent it falling into enemy hands, absorbing the astronomical cosmic energies of the Tesseract (Space Stone). Amnesiac and indoctrinated as the Kree warrior 'Vers' on Hala, Carol was captured by Skrulls and crash-landed on Earth in 1995. Partnering with a young S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Nick Fury, Carol unlocked her suppressed memories, dismantled the Supreme Intelligence's control chip, and ignited her full Binary potential, inspiring Fury to draft the Avengers Initiative.

FTL interstellar self-propelled flight and spatial survival
Cosmic-level physical strength, invulnerability, and radiant binary aura
Energy absorption and kinetic transmutation

name: Ant-Man
tagline: The reformed ex-con who unlocked the Quantum Realm and saved half the universe
biography: Scott Edward Harris Lang was an expert systems engineer who served three years in San Quentin after executing an ethical whistleblowing cyber-heist against his corrupt employer Vistacorp. Struggling to secure honest employment to support his young daughter Cassie, Lang was drawn into a staged burglary at Dr. Hank Pym's residence, discovering the Ant-Man suit. Chosen by Pym to succeed him, Lang mastered Pym Particle shrinking and ant telepathy to defeat Darren Cross. Trapped in the Quantum Realm during Thanos' snap, Lang emerged five hours later (five Earth years) with the crucial quantum time travel theory that allowed the Avengers to execute the Time Heist.

name: Winter Soldier / Bucky
tagline: The Howling Commando survivor who broke free from seventy years of mind control
biography: James Buchanan 'Bucky' Barnes was Steve Rogers' loyal childhood companion who enlisted in the 107th Infantry during WWII. Captured by HYDRA in Austrian territory, Barnes was subjected to early biological enhancement by Arnim Zola before Captain America liberated him. Reunited as Howling Commandos, Barnes fell from a speeding munitions train in the Alps and was recovered by Soviet HYDRA operatives. Fitted with a cybernetic titanium arm and subjected to cryostasis and memory-erasing mental trigger codes, Barnes became the legendary assassin 'The Winter Soldier.' Steve Rogers helped him remember his humanity, and Shuri later cured his trigger words in Wakanda.

Vibranium cybernetic arm equipped with internal kinetic dampening and extreme crushing force
Mastery of master-level knife combat, hand-to-hand martial arts, and military firearms

name: Captain America / Falcon
tagline: The high-flying pararescue airman who accepted the shield of Captain America
biography: Samuel Thomas Wilson was a former United States Air Force Pararescue airman who operated the experimental EXO-7 Falcon flight harness during tactical night missions. Following the loss of his wingman Riley, Wilson worked as a VA counselor in Washington D.C., where he befriended Steve Rogers. When HYDRA compromised S.H.I.E.L.D., Wilson donned his Falcon wings to aid Rogers in taking down Project Insight. Wilson became a devoted Avenger, took Steve's side in the Civil War, and fought Thanos' forces in Infinity War and Endgame. At the end of Endgame, an aged Steve Rogers formally passed his shield to Wilson, who eventually accepted the mantle of Captain America.

Peak human military martial combat and shield-throwing trajectory calculations
Inspirational leadership, empathy, and diplomatic mediation

name: Loki
tagline: The God of Mischief whose path from conqueror to savior bound the multiverse
biography: Loki Laufeyson was the biological son of King Laufey of Jotunheim, adopted as an abandoned infant by King Odin of Asgard and raised alongside Thor. Learning in adulthood of his Frost Giant heritage, Loki's feelings of inferiority and betrayal exploded into a succession of schemes: attempting to destroy Jotunheim, leading a Chitauri invasion of New York City for the Tesseract, and seizing the Asgardian throne under Odin's guise. Reconciling with Thor during Ragnarok, Loki sacrificed himself in Infinity War defying Thanos. An alternate 2012 variant escaped with the Tesseract to the TVA, evolving to master time-slipping and sacrificing personal freedom to hold together the branches of the multiverse as the God of Stories.

name: Nick Fury
tagline: The mastermind director of S.H.I.E.L.D. who brought together the Avengers
biography: Nicholas Joseph Fury was a decorated Cold War CIA officer who rose through the ranks of the Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (S.H.I.E.L.D.) to become its legendary Director. In 1995, an encounter with Carol Danvers and the alien Skrulls convinced Fury that humanity was woefully unprepared for extraterrestrial threats, prompting him to create the Avengers Initiative. Working from the shadows, Fury brought together Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye when Loki invaded Earth. Surviving HYDRA's assassination attempt in Washington D.C., Fury continued running covert operations across the cosmos.

Expert military tactician and firearms marksmanship
Network of clandestine safehouses, covert resources, and global contacts

name: Storm
tagline: The weather-wielding mutant leader and teacher at Xavier's School
biography: Ororo Munroe is an Omega-level mutant born with the ability to psionically manipulate atmospheric weather patterns. Recruited by Charles Xavier into the X-Men, Ororo became a central teacher and field leader at the Xavier Institute. Capable of generating hurricane winds, lightning bolts, and blizzard temperatures at will, Storm remained an unflinching protector of both young mutants and peaceful coexistence, eventually succeeding Xavier as the operational head of the school.

Generation of lightning bolts, tornadoes, blizzards, and fog banks
Atmospheric thermal flight via wind currents
Immunity to extreme environmental weather extremes

name: Jean Grey / Phoenix
tagline: The Class 5 telekinetic mutant carrying the devastating Phoenix force
biography: Dr. Jean Grey was an accomplished geneticist, physician, and founding senior member of the X-Men. Possessing Class 5 telepathy and telekinesis, Jean's boundless psionic potential was guarded by mental blocks installed by Charles Xavier in childhood to shield her sanity. Sacrificing her life to hold back the bursting Alkali Lake dam in X2, Jean re-emerged in The Last Stand as the unrestrained, omnipotent Phoenix. Torn between her compassionate nature and the destructive entity within, Jean begged Logan to end her life on Alcatraz to stop the catastrophe.
powers: Class 5 molecular telekinesis capable of disintegrating matter at an atomic level
Vast psionic telepathy and mind reading
Telekinetic flight and spherical force shields
equipment: Custom medical and tactical X-Men suits

name: Cyclops
tagline: The disciplined field commander and optic-blast anchor of the X-Men
biography: Scott Summers was Charles Xavier's first student and the steadfast field commander of the X-Men. Scott's mutation produces continuous, uncontrollable beams of red concussive force from his eyes, which can only be held in check by ruby-quartz lenses and his specialized battle visor. Dedicated to Xavier's dream of human-mutant harmony, Cyclops led the X-Men against Magneto's Brotherhood on Liberty Island and William Stryker at Alkali Lake, standing as the tactical backbone of the team.

Spatial awareness and geometric bank-shot calculation
Mastery of small-unit tactical leadership and martial arts
